excerpts.text: # p.relTol 单变量对照：local 改善，steady启动迭代压力换号仍在
**唯一数值改变 `p.relTol 0.05→0.005`；从相同 checkpoint1，仅 outer2–4。一次启动已用完，无继续/自动重试。**
实际完成3个原生写场及完整观测，exit0、原生End、无停止异常。native启动至最终观测/终止决策 **21.832659 s**（45s上限），清理另 0.031598 s；只读baseline预检另计。单逻辑CPU、各进程1线程，硬AS1280+704+64MiB=2GiB；采样aggregate RSS峰值 1133867008 B（不是精确瞬时峰值）。

- **仍存在的启动迭代压力换号：** outer2 pmax=2.51109e-6，outer3 pmax=4.00081e-7，outer4 pmin=−1.10936e-6；基线outer4 pmin=−1.07730e-6。本次负向幅值略大，Δp/p=1.36802。收紧到0.005并未消除这三个未收敛steady启动迭代的固定参考压力极值换号；不能推广为所有内层误差都无关，也不能仅剩“mesh坏”一个原因。
已从observer代码核实：`Δp/p = ||p_n−p_(n−1)||₂ / ||p_n||₂`，是**当前场**非体积加权范数分母。摘要未保存独立分子/分母，故本次不能定量拆分“分母接近零”的放大贡献，也不重读大场取数。outer3的p幅值较outer2小很多与Δp/p很大同时出现，支持需要警惕分母效应，但极值不是L2范数，不能用极值替代证明。
基线/候选都固定出口p=0，参考定义未变，无参考压力漂移证据。不过p的相对范数量本身依赖压力零点，不是参考不变的物理指标。outer4在同一零点下负向极值确实存在（不只是百分比分母伪象）；严格只能说保存场极值从正向占优变成负向占优，不能仅凭极值声称全部单元或端口平均压差都换号。负的kinematic gauge pressure也不等于负绝对压力。
这些Time索引是未收敛的steady SIMPLE启动迭代，不是物理时间序列。现有证据可说“启动迭代压力摆动、尚未证稳”，不能说已经发现实物的周期振荡或物理不稳定。
1. 同时保存相邻场变化的绝对量、体积加权RMS，以及独立分子/分母；采用预先固定的物理/参考尺度作无量纲量，不依赖可能很小的当前p范数。需要网格体积和完整场，本次未计算。
4. 只有上述观测可靠、无gross/非有限/未知BC异常，且固定同一checkpoint及一个数值方案、明确有限outer/壁钟/AS预算与终止理由，才有评审有限续算的依据；三步local改善不自动选出“最佳方案”。若窗口内仍不稳定，按预算终态收口，不自动补跑或再扫参数。R1物理/网格/manufactured门仍独立阻塞。

excerpts.text: **Result:** at time/index 17, the frozen raw momentum residual fell only **11.208% in integrated L2** (8.028% in volume RMS), while the relaxed residual fell **96.220%** (95.112%). A small relaxed linear remainder is not a small raw fixed-point defect, local convergence, a physically valid boundary condition, or engineering release.

4. The log gives `ΣD_rel/ΣD_raw = 1.484112`, not `1/0.7 = 1.428571`. The excess over `ΣD_raw/0.7` is **4.106072802e-4 m³/s**, 11.4727% of the signed aggregate ΔD. This falsifies a simple `D/alpha` model for this event. It does not distinguish boundary handling from dominance/sign augmentation or establish relaxation as root cause.

**Use one held-operator continuation, not an alpha/scheme sweep.** The question is whether further reduction of the relaxed solve remainder on *the exact same equation* materially reduces the raw defect, or whether the compensation remains. Existing changed-trajectory relTol comparisons cannot answer that frozen-system question.

- A separately reviewed/authorized bounded native observation must retain hashes of the actual assembled raw and relaxed complete operators, sources, Uold, pressure RHS, volumes, addressing and evaluated boundary operands. The current event has no retained frozen-q/operator hashes and cannot be replayed from these eight summaries. Do not reassemble saved fields and call that the observed frozen system.

- At each matched checkpoint reduce `r_raw`, `r_rel`, `C=ΔDΔU`, their dot products and identity defects in integrated and volume-weighted metrics. Record complete-domain maxima of `|r|/V` and a predeclared bounded set of baseline-selected cell IDs with V and signed vectors; keep the same IDs at subsequent checkpoints. Domain norms/global conservation cannot certify local convergence.

`analyze.py` is a standard-library, read-only analyzer. It verifies the raw/event/attempt linkage, emits absolute and relative metrics separately, calculates norm-specific triangle bounds, reports unavailable quantities as null/NOT_CAPTURED, and refuses output overwrite. `native_relaxation_decomposition()` is a tiny scalar planning/synthetic oracle, not a native mesh reconstruction.

18 new targeted synthetic tests cover sharp/opposite/orthogonal norm cases, nonuniform-volume weighting, undefined ratios, identity envelopes, native diagonal decomposition, alpha=1 nonidentity, units/nonfinite/duplicate/mixed-event/hash rejection and absence of false acceptance. excerpts.text: - After scope refinement allowed public source browsing, the official migrated repository supplied **tag `OpenFOAM-v1912`** source. This is not a claim of byte-identical source for Debian `1912.200626-3+b1`. The exact patch tag/commit could not be resolved through the web tool; no remote source-byte hash is claimed. Failed old-host/API/helper retrievals were not replaced by a newer release.

Baseline `case/system/fvSolution` line 4 specifies p GAMG/GaussSeidel, absolute tolerance `1e-10`, `relTol 0.05`, `maxIter 100`. There is no pFinal entry. Line 7 specifies one additional nonorthogonal corrector and `consistent no`; line 8 has pressure field relaxation 0.3 and U equation relaxation 0.7. `fvSchemes` lines 2–7 use steadyState, bounded upwind momentum convection, and limited 0.5 Laplacian/snGrad. `controlDict` line 7 sets deltaT=1, and line 16 forbids runtime dictionary modification. The A/B changes only p.relTol to 0.005 numerically; its endTime change is a budget limit.

The baseline pressure diagnosis already independently extracted all 30 solves: every final residual exceeds 1e-10, every final/initial ratio is below 0.05, and none reaches maxIter=100. At outer15, the second solve is `0.13735887012709364 → 0.0068347364574117067`, one iteration (baseline log lines 182–183). Thus the observed stop is consistent with the relative branch, not absolute tolerance or the iteration cap. It is not evidence of a pressure solve to 1e-10 or outer convergence.

In v1912, [GAMGSolverSolve.C](https://gitlab.com/openfoam/core/openfoam/-/raw/OpenFOAM-v1912/src/OpenFOAM/matrices/lduMatrix/solvers/GAMG/GAMGSolverSolve.C) lines 53–76 form a solve-specific normalization N and the initial normalized L1 residual; lines 127–146 recompute the final L1 residual and stop on convergence or maxIter, subject to minIter. [SolverPerformance.C](https://gitlab.com/openfoam/core/openfoam/-/raw/OpenFOAM-v1912/src/OpenFOAM/matrices/LduMatrix/LduMatrix/SolverPerformance.C), lines 70–87, accepts absolute tolerance **or**, for active relTol, `finalResidual_ < cmptMultiply(RelTolerance, initialResidual_)`. [lduMatrixSolver.C](https://gitlab.com/openfoam/core/openfoam/-/raw/OpenFOAM-v1912/src/OpenFOAM/matrices/lduMatrix/lduMatrix/lduMatrixSolver.C), lines 151–156, reads those controls with minIter default 0. Its lines 182–200 show N depends on the initial pressure, matrix, source and a reference-pressure average; N is not total mesh volume.

The needed same-stage matrix/residual/N were not saved, so this observation cannot be established from the current checkpoints and is **not authorization for instrumentation, build or CFD**. Exact patch200626 source identity remains a prerequisite before implementing it. No relTol sweep, new geometry investigation or new acceptance framework is proposed.

Only this new report was written. Existing evidence was not edited; no claim of newly rehashing all large fields or meshes is made. Linear context was attempted once and returned `McpServerError: Tool get_agent_context not found`; no retry or remote write. Source retrieval limitations were unavailable/cache-miss results, not a filesystem permission denial.
